skill.name: no-mistakes
skill.description: Guide code changes through the no-mistakes review, test, lint, documentation, push, pull request, and CI pipeline.
skill.summary: Run and manage no-mistakes validation while preserving user intent, repository state, and approval boundaries.
skill.author: kunchenguid

security_audit.summary: All 153 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, or unrelated prose. The skill still carries medium operational risk because it drives repository publication, accepts tool-supplied commands, and can resolve gates unattended with consent. No prompt injection or concealed malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Commands returned by external tool output are treated as executable instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist supported no-mistakes subcommands and arguments before execution. Reject unexpected commands and shell metacharacters.

remediation.issue: The workflow can commit, rebase, push, and create pull requests.
remediation.suggestion: Show the branch, remote, and planned publishing actions before the first mutating pipeline command. Require task-scoped user authorization.

remediation.issue: The --yes mode can resolve ask-user findings without per-finding confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation for each unattended run and summarize eligible findings before applying fixes or approvals.

content.user_title: Validate and Ship Code Changes Safely
content.value_statement: Complex delivery pipelines can lose intent or mishandle repository state. This skill guides no-mistakes runs through review, testing, publication, and CI decisions.
actual_capabilities: Checks branch scope and preserves unrelated working tree changes.
Starts validation with the user's complete intent and constraints.
Processes review, test, lint, documentation, push, pull request, and CI stages.
Routes automatic fixes, informational findings, and user decisions through distinct gate actions.
Handles branch synchronization and recovery using structured pipeline state.
Reports fixes, skips, overrides, failures, and successful outcomes.
limitations: Requires an installed no-mistakes command, initialized repository, daemon, and configured pipeline agent.
Requires committed work on a feature branch before validation starts.
Can change Git history and remote repository state through the external pipeline.
Cannot resolve protected paths or unvalidated test work without operator involvement.

use_cases.title: Validate a Feature
use_cases.description: Run committed feature work through review, tests, lint, documentation, and CI before requesting merge.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Coordinate push and pull request stages while preserving explicit release constraints and reporting exceptions.

use_cases.title: Recover Pipeline Custody
use_cases.description: Interpret branch synchronization state and recover preserved pipeline commits without improvising destructive Git operations.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Committed Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Run no-mistakes on my committed feature branch. Use this intent: [goal]. Ask me about every ask-user finding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation of an existing change

prompt_templates.title: Complete and Validate a Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Complete [task], commit only relevant changes on a feature branch, then run no-mistakes with my full original intent.

prompt_templates.title: Validate with Approved Skips
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this branch and skip [step] as authorized. Report every skip, override, pipeline fix, and final outcome.

prompt_templates.title: Drive an Unattended Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full pipeline with --yes. Preserve unrelated work, honor protected-path refusals, and stop after checks pass.

output_examples.input: Validate my committed feature and stop for product decisions.
output_examples.output: Validation reached review. One mechanical fix was applied. A product behavior finding needs your decision before the pipeline continues.

output_examples.input: Drive the approved pipeline until CI is ready.
output_examples.output: Review, tests, documentation, lint, push, and CI completed. The pull request is ready for human review and merge.

output_examples.input: Explain why the run did not publish.
output_examples.output: The run passed local checks but skipped publication because remote credentials were unavailable. No pull request was created.

best_practices: Provide the complete user goal, constraints, exclusions, and decisions as pipeline intent.
Inspect structured branch synchronization state before committing follow-up work or starting another run.
Report every automatic fix, skip, override, and missing validation signal.
anti_patterns: Do not start validation from the default branch or with uncommitted task changes.
Do not approve ask-user findings without direct consent or an explicit unattended request.
Do not reset, rebase, abort, or replace branches while the pipeline owns an active run.

faq.question: What must be configured first?
faq.answer: Install no-mistakes, initialize the repository, run its daemon, and configure a supported pipeline agent.

faq.question: Can it validate uncommitted changes?
faq.answer: No. The workflow validates committed history on a feature branch.

faq.question: Can it push code and create pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes. The configured pipeline may push branches, create pull requests, and monitor CI.

faq.question: How are product decisions handled?
faq.answer: Findings marked ask-user stop the run until the user chooses to fix, approve, or skip them.

faq.question: What does --yes authorize?
faq.answer: It permits eligible findings to be fixed and approved without repeated questions. Protected paths still require operator action.

faq.question: What happens after checks pass?
faq.answer: The skill reports the pull request as ready. A human reviews and merges it.
